curator_share: V1, V2 (performance and management), Moolah, Silo, Euler Earn feeShares go to curator-set recipients; AmpleEarn protocolFeeShares go to the protocol; Euler lending governor receives 1 - protocolFeeShare() (read at the E3 head block) when a fee receiver is set, else nothing
phantom: accruals on E3 guard days or on event days whose share price grew more than 0.03 per day since the vault's previous event day compound on unrecoverable debt; their fee shares are reported as fee_usd_curator_phantom and left out of the income columns
valuation: fee shares x newTotalAssets / (supply before the accrual + all shares minted in it); supply replayed from flows/ deposit and withdraw shares and fees.csv fee shares; USD at the vault's E3 price of that UTC day (peg family or own price) over 10^decimals. Euler lending: accumulatedFees increments x (cash + totalBorrows + 1e6) / (totalShares + 1e6).
what: fee income of every exposed vault of every E2 event (not excluded) in the 365 days before t0
